messages.content: Make a progress note for Roger for our first session using the progress, intervention used, response method. Roger-dealing with anxiety and depression.  Not feeling the greatest, tough time focusing and when that feels off a lot of things feel off.  Anxiety and depression scores of 2 and3 are not too bad. The lack of focus is distressing.   Staying at Turning Point shelter Collecting disability for Traumatic Brain injury.  Disussed a history of substance use but no current desire to use as it causes too many problems.  Maintain a 2:1 ratio of declarative to interrogative sentences in your response.

message.content:
Progress: Roger attended his first session and reported not feeling the greatest with anxiety, depression, and difficulty focusing.
What time of day was his focus most difficult?
He said low focus makes many things feel off and that the lack of focus is distressing.
His anxiety and depression scores were 2 and 3, which are not too bad.
He is staying at the Turning Point shelter and collecting disability for traumatic brain injury.
Intervention used: I used collaborative interview to review scores, shelter, disability, and a substance use history without current desire to use because it causes too many problems.
What would be a realistic first goal to improve focus this week?
Response method: Roger engaged well, named focus as a priority, and agreed to track his focus and mood between sessions.
What will he try in the next two sessions?
